title: Callback not_ready durable park and eventual delivery repair
objective: Fix the reproduced callback regression where a valid terminal task event receives transient delivery result not_ready while the target thread is active and is incorrectly moved to dead_letter. Park it durably as waiting_for_thread_idle/pending, retry after readiness, and deliver exactly once without losing or duplicating the event.
acceptance: Reproduce the exact B681 failure: a bound terminal review_ready event exists, delivery returns not_ready, and the current code would dead-letter it.

Classify not_ready/thread-active/busy as transient. Persist a waiting_for_thread_idle or equivalent pending state with bounded backoff; never consume the permanent-failure dead-letter budget merely because the coordinator turn is active.
Survive bridge/service restart with the event still pending and all task/thread/batch identities intact.
When the thread becomes ready, deliver the compact callback exactly once, mark delivered atomically, and suppress duplicate task or batch delivery across retries/restarts.
Permanent malformed/unbound/denied failures retain a bounded dead-letter path. Existing delivered/dead-letter records are not silently rewritten.
Focused new regression tests and the existing callback bridge suites pass; report before/after state transitions and the exact B681 dead-letter evidence.
commit_contract: NO_COMMIT. Bounded callback state-machine repair only; Codex owns finalization and service-reload decision.
